stories.headline: A free coding model just matched paid ones
stories.summary: Sample story. A fictional lab, Northwind AI, released an open coding model that scores close to paid assistants on common benchmarks.
stories.why: You could run a strong coding helper locally without a subscription.

stories.headline: Voice mode arrives in a popular chat app
stories.summary: Sample story. A fictional chat app added hands-free voice conversations for all users, including the free plan.
stories.why: Talking to AI while commuting just got easier.

stories.headline: New rules for labelling AI-generated images
stories.summary: Sample story. A fictional regulator proposed that platforms must label AI-made images and video shown to users.
stories.why: Expect more 'made with AI' tags on your feed.

stories.headline: Spreadsheet assistant writes formulas from plain English
stories.summary: Sample story. A fictional office suite now turns typed requests into working formulas and charts.
stories.why: Fewer late nights fighting with nested formulas.

stories.headline: Smaller models learn faster with better data
stories.summary: Sample story. Fictional researchers showed a small model trained on cleaner data beating one ten times its size.
stories.why: Good AI may soon run fully on your phone.

stories.headline: Indian AI startup raises funds for Tamil and Hindi models
stories.summary: Sample story. A fictional Bengaluru startup raised money to build speech models for Indian languages.
stories.why: Better AI in the languages people actually speak at home.

stories.headline: Popular image model goes open source
stories.summary: Sample story. A fictional studio released the weights of its image model under a permissive licence.
stories.why: Developers can build image apps without paying per image.

stories.headline: Chip shortage pushes up cloud GPU prices
stories.summary: Sample story. Fictional cloud providers raised GPU rental prices as demand for AI training kept growing.
stories.why: AI products may get pricier before they get cheaper.

stories.headline: Browser adds an AI agent that books tickets for you
stories.summary: Sample story. A fictional browser can now fill forms and complete bookings after you approve each step.
stories.why: Routine online chores could take one sentence instead of ten clicks.

stories.headline: AI spots crop disease from a phone photo
stories.summary: Sample story. A fictional agri-tech team built a model that flags leaf diseases from a single photo.
stories.why: Farmers could get answers in seconds instead of days.

caption_hook: Ten AI stories from yesterday, explained in one line each.
